## Checklist

- [ ] Scoped to one work unit; tests and docs ship with the behavior
- [ ] Authored diff is about 400 changed lines or less (or the overage is explained above)
- [ ] `task check` passes locally
- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`feat(scope): ...`, `fix(scope): ...`)
- [ ] User-visible change documented (README, docs site, or help text)
